evaluation_label: experimental, supplementary: FSC-147-trained frozen-feature counting transfer on a CountQA-derived subset with AI-authored exemplar boxes; not official CountQA benchmark scores and not comparable to published CountQA MLLM results
annotator: gpt-6-astra, three AI visual annotator instances through Codex/T3; independent second-pass AI adjudicator on 26 items
coordinates: box_px: continuous source pixels (x0, y0, x1, y1) of the released image; box_source_unit: box_px / (w, h, w, h); box_letterbox_unit: counting.letterbox_frame(w, h).boxes, rounded to 6 decimals

source.tool: Local multimodal visual annotation with source-image contact sheets, manual AI-selected xyxy coordinates, and visual overlay rechecks; merge_validate_ai.py; apply_adjudication_v2.py

parent_ai_spot_check.parent_note: Lower-left storage box may be clipped at left frame edge. Independent adjudication requested.
Top platter may be clipped at left image edge; lower box boundary may include next platter. Independent adjudication requested.

review_coverage.statement: All439 images were inspected by assigned AI annotators. All325 final boxes received visual overlay review by an annotator or independent adjudicator. The parent spot-checked 24 items; an independent AI adjudicator reviewed26 items. This is not a full independent review or human review. The first-pass records are preserved.

limitations: FSC-147 to CountQA transfer: heads trained on centre crops read letterboxed whole images with padding and smaller objects.
Exemplars are AI-selected (gpt-6-astra) and not human-reviewed; box errors and target-identity errors are possible.
Only questions with a clean exemplar are included; this may systematically exclude hard images.
Sensitivity to the choice of exemplar and stability of model rankings under alternative exemplars or protocol choices are not established.
